test_inverse_normal_cdf: test the inverse_normal_cdf function to compute z-values for given probabilities in a normal distribution
test_inverse_chi2_cdf: test the inverse_chi2_cdf function to compute chi-squared critical values for given degrees of freedom and probabilities
test_mean_equality_hypothesis_test: test the mean_equality_hypothesis_test function to check if a sample mean falls within the confidence interval of a true mean
test_mean_equality_confidence_interval: test the mean_equality_hypothesis_confidence_interval function to compute lower and upper bounds for a mean equality confidence interval
test_variance_equality_hypothesis_test: test the variance_equality_hypothesis_test function to check if a sample standard deviation falls within the confidence interval of a true standard deviation
